steps.label: Round 3 (increase round)
steps.instruction: Knit chart A, rnds 1-3. After rnd 3, you have 144 sts.

chart.text: *k2 cc, m1 cc, k1 cc, k1 mc, m1 cc, k2 cc, m1 cc, k1 cc, k1 mc, m1 cc*, repeat 12 times

steps.label: Round 27
steps.instruction: Continue chart A, rnds 27-48 (no further increases).

chart.text: *k2 cc, k3 mc, k3 cc, k2 mc, k4 cc, k3 mc, k3 cc*, repeat 12 times
